answer: Witnessed Compute Ledger. Each identity must periodically submit verifiable proofs of useful computation witnessed by three unaffiliated peers. A small rotating mesa of validators checks results; falsified work triggers a bridge to a quarantine state, freezing the identity's routing. Registration is free but cold-start requires a delta of 40 witnessed hours before any transaction rights. An attacker pays 40 hours of parallel real compute per sybil, and parallelism itself is capped by each peer's witnessing throughput. Cost scales linearly with identity count, not with money.
